title: 2001 Topps Archives #90 John Elway Denver Broncos Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2001 Topps Archives football card features John Elway, the legendary quarterback for the Denver Broncos. With a standard card size made of high-quality card stock, this licensed reprint is a must-have for any NFL fan or sports trading card collector. The card showcases Elway in action and includes his card number, 90, from the 2001 season.

This rare card is an excellent addition to any collection and is a great way to celebrate the incredible career of one of the NFL's greatest players. Whether you are a die-hard Broncos fan or just a lover of football, this card is a valuable item that you don't want to miss out on.
